PLAN "Pregnancy Strength Maintenance (12 Weeks)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Maintain strength and movement quality during pregnancy"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1: Foundation and Volume" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Lower Body Strength A":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          calf_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          pallof_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Upper Body Strength A (Incline)":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_press 4x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 4x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Lower Body Strength B":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          trap_bar_deadlift 4x4 rpe 6 rest 150 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x8 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
